# Flipp

> Flipp is a free, privacy-first, browser-based PDF toolkit. All file processing happens 100% locally in the user's browser using WebAssembly and Web APIs. No files are uploaded to any server.

## Overview

Flipp provides browser-based PDF manipulation tools designed for complete privacy and security. Unlike server-side PDF services, Flipp never transmits, stores, or logs your documents or personal data.

- **Primary Purpose:** Provide fast, secure, and private PDF editing, conversion, and utility tools directly in the browser.
- **Privacy Guarantee:** 100% client-side execution—your files never leave your device.
- **Cost & Access:** Free, no registration or account required, no file size limits or paywalls.

## Available PDF Tools

### Conversion Tools
- [PDF to Word](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/pdf-to-word/) — Convert PDF documents to editable Word (.docx) files.
- [PDF to PNG](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/pdf-to-png/) — Convert PDF pages into high-resolution PNG or JPG images.
- [Images to PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/images-to-pdf/) — Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into PDF documents.
- [PDF to Text](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/pdf-to-text/) — Extract plain text content from PDF documents.
- [Text to PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/text-to-pdf/) — Convert plain text files into clean PDF documents.

### Organization & Page Management
- [Merge PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/merge-pdf/) — Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
- [Split PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/split-pdf/) — Split a PDF document into separate page ranges or individual files.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/delete-pdf-pages/) — Delete unwanted pages from a PDF document.
- [Rearrange PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/rearrange-pdf/) — Reorder, rotate, or organize PDF pages.

### Security & Optimization
- [Compress PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/compress-pdf/) — Reduce PDF file size while maintaining visual quality.
- [Protect PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/protect-pdf/) — Encrypt PDF documents with password protection.
- [Unlock PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/unlock-pdf/) — Remove password protection or restrictions from PDF files.

### Editing & Annotation
- [Edit PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/edit-pdf/) — Add text, freehand drawings, highlights, and images directly to PDF pages.
- [Add Watermark](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/add-watermark/) — Add custom text watermarks to PDF pages.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/add-page-numbers/) — Insert customizable page numbers into PDF documents.
- [Sign PDF](https://tryflipp.pages.dev/tools/sign-pdf/) — Sign PDF documents with drawn signatures or image signatures.

## Important Capabilities & Privacy Features

- **Client-Side Technology:** Leverages PDF.js, pdf-lib, Tesseract.js, and WebAssembly for in-browser processing.
- **Sensitive Document Processing:** Ideal for processing bank statements, tax forms, medical records, legal contracts, and personal documents without third-party exposure.
- **Offline Capability:** Works seamlessly without sending data back to central servers after page load.
